title: Obsidian Metric0 Rolling 7-Day Value Average
dataSources: Obsidian graph stats (`obsidian:stats`), Roam daily notes (`roam:daily`), Logseq tasks (`logseq:task`), Zettelkasten notes (`zettel:note`), PKM review summaries (`pkm:review`).
app: Obsidian graph stats, Roam daily notes, Logseq task exports, and Zettelkasten counts streamed to Splunk HEC via plugins, CSV exports, and scripted vault scans.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=obsidian:metric0 value=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(value) as daily_avg by _time
| streamstats window=7 avg(daily_avg) as rolling_7d
| sort _time
description: Tracks a seven-day rolling average of daily value for obsidian metric0 data.
value: Rolling averages highlight gradual drift without overreacting to one-off days.
implementation: Compute daily average `value` then a seven-day rolling mean for obsidian metric0 events.
visualization: Line chart of daily and rolling average value.
grandmaExplanation: It reviews the smoothed week-long trend in your value from obsidian metric0.
